title: Fisherman's Retreat-Boat Slip & Fishing on Deck

services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: Welcome to the Fisherman's Retreat! Centrally located in the heart of Port Isabel, this newly renovated and well appointed 2 bedroom, 1 bath boasts an open floor plan which is perfect for lounging with family and friends after enjoying a long day of fishing! This property has a dedicated boat slip off of the back deck which is connected to the marina. The boat fee is available for use for a fee. In addition, you can fish off of the back deck in the marina. The boat ramp is located 2 minutes away within the neighborhood.
